added.description: Incoming documents stored (a repeated id counts each occurrence).

effectiveFrom.description: When the link takes effect on the valid-time axis.

oneOf.description: This fact (transitively) supersedes the linked one.
The linked fact (transitively) supersedes this one.

ConsolidationReport.description: What a consolidation run did or would do.

created.description: Facts written; each supersedes its sources.

forgotten.description: Sources removed. Empty unless destructive consolidation was explicitly allowed.

DocIn.description:
One document. `vector` has exactly `--input-dim` finite numbers (omit it only when the server
embeds text on-device).

import_adopt_legacy.description: Explicitly adopt a matching legacy source record without an owner stamp.

DocumentChunkRecord.description:
One retained chunk, with its source byte span and document metadata.
`text` is absent when text retention was disabled; spans do not restore omitted whitespace.

revision.description: Opaque store revision captured with this chunk; compare across reads, do not interpret numerically.

DocumentInfo.description: Document identity, provenance and metadata without copying stored chunk text.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last page.

asOf.description: Evaluate validity and supersession at this time. Absent: the clock's now.

candidateLimit.description: Eligible candidates ranked before optional recency adjustment; defaults to document search's.

entities.description: Only facts mentioning at least one of these entities.

explain.description: Attach an [`Explanation`] to every result. Costs nothing when false.

filter.description: Exact top-level metadata matches, as in document search.

k.description: Results to return; the configured default (10) when absent. At most 1000.

knownAt.description:
Evaluate what the store knew at this ingest time: later facts and later supersessions
are ignored. Absent: everything stored.

Explanation.description: Why a fact matched and how it was adjusted.

historicalFactor.description: The multiplier for a non-current fact (`historicalWeight`); 1 for a current one.

matchedTerms.description: Query words that match the fact's text (after stemming).

rank.description: 1-based position among the ranked candidates, after the recency policy.

recencyFactor.description: The recency policy's multiplier; 1 when none is configured.

retrievalScore.description: The fused document search score before the recency policy.

retrieved.description:
False when the fact was not among the ranked candidates for the query (explain
still reports its terms, validity and chain).

FactRecord.description: A stored fact with its history links, as `get` and `history` return it.

effectiveFrom.description: When the fact takes effect on the valid-time axis.

FactStatus.description: A fact's standing at the time recall evaluates it.

oneOf.description: A newer fact supersedes it; it stays stored as history.
Its validity interval has not started.

forgotten.description: Ids removed (or, for a dry run, that would be removed), sorted.

dryRun.description: Report what would be removed without removing it.

includeChain.description:
Also remove every fact linked to a matched one by supersession, in both directions,
so no version of the chain survives. Default: only the matched facts; a successor's
removal makes its predecessor current again.

purge.description:
Compact the store afterwards. Deleted text stays in the append-only journal until a
compaction rewrites it; this makes the removal physical.

oneOf.description: Facts whose event time (else valid-from, else ingest time) is before this time.
Facts whose caller metadata contains all these top-level values.
Only facts that are current at the evaluation time. The default.
Every fact, with its status; ranking is unchanged.
Only facts that are not current: superseded, expired or not yet valid.

IdRequest.description: `get` and `history` retain their legacy acceptance of extra request fields.

score.description: Exact cosine similarity for vector queries; fused rank score for text queries.

text.description: Stored text, empty when the document was stored without text.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details, plus the deprecated `error` object kept for v1 SDK clients.

document_ids.description: Intersect metadata filtering with 1..=1000 explicit document IDs; uses exact scoring.

ef.description: Beam width of a graph-index query, 1..=4096 (recall knob). Default: `--query-ef`.

filter.description: Keep documents whose metadata contains every key with an equal JSON value.

index.description:
Route of an unfiltered vector query: `auto` (the graph index when built, else the
exact scan), `exact` or `graph` (409 `index_unavailable` until maintenance built one).
Default: the server's `--query-index`.

query.description: Text query; requires the on-device model stages (`local-models`).

today.description: Date relative times in `query` resolve against (query rewriting).

asOf.description: Evaluate validity and supersession at this time. Absent: the clock's now.

candidateLimit.description: Eligible candidates ranked before optional recency adjustment; defaults to document search's.

entities.description: Only facts mentioning at least one of these entities.

explain.description: Attach an [`Explanation`] to every result. Costs nothing when false.

filter.description: Exact top-level metadata matches, as in document search.

k.description: Results to return; the configured default (10) when absent. At most 1000.

knownAt.description:
Evaluate what the store knew at this ingest time: later facts and later supersessions
are ignored. Absent: everything stored.

metadata.description: The caller's metadata, without the reserved `_mem` key.

score.description: The document search score after the recency policy.

embedding.description: A dense embedding of the text, when the store has an embedding space.

entities.description: Entities the fact mentions; matched exactly by `RecallOptions::entities`.

eventTime.description:
When the thing the fact describes happened (for example a conversation's date). It is
not the ingest time, which the store records itself.

id.description:
Caller-chosen id. Absent: a deterministic id derived from the content, so retrying the
same call stores the same fact once. Ids may not start with `hms:`.

metadata.description:
Caller metadata (a JSON object); exact top-level matches work as recall filters.
The key `_mem` is reserved.

subject.description: What the fact is about; the key supersession policies match on.

supersedes.description: Ids of facts this one replaces. They are kept and stay queryable as history.

validFrom.description: Start of the interval in which the fact holds. Absent: unbounded.

validTo.description: End (exclusive) of the interval in which the fact holds. Absent: unbounded.

created.description: False when the identical fact was already stored under this id (an idempotent retry).

supersededBy.description: Facts that already supersede this one (a late-arriving older fact).

supersedes.description: Facts this one supersedes, explicit and policy-resolved.

previous_snapshot.description: The replaced store, kept as a snapshot with this id.

SearchHit.description: One text search hit. `text` and `metadata` are present only when named in `include`.

score.description: BM25 score; the fused rank score when the server runs on-device model stages.

SearchIn.description: A lexical text query over the tenant's documents (memory facts included).

include.description: Extra fields per hit: any of `"text"` and `"metadata"`. Default: ids and scores only.

query.description: 1..=8192 bytes with at least one word.

tenants.description: Tenants with a store on disk.

VectorIndexBody.description: The vector snapshot that answers unfiltered vector queries (see `--query-index`).

current.description:
Whether the snapshot is the live store. A stale snapshot still answers correctly:
deleted and replaced documents are dropped and new ones scored exactly.

graph.description: Whether a graph index is built over the snapshot (`auto` queries use it).

rebuildRecommended.description: Whether the next index maintenance or compaction will capture a fresh snapshot.

rows.description: Embedded chunks the snapshot covers; 0 until maintenance builds one.

staleMutations.description: Inserts, replaces and deletes since the snapshot was captured.

bearerAuth.description: API key. Scopes: read, write, admin (admin includes read and write). Keys are bound to tenants.

info.description: One engine store per tenant. The /api/v1 contract is stable: see docs/server/versioning.md. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details.
